name: tally
description: Tally — a shared household checklist that resets on a cadence you choose

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tally/shared && npm run build -w @tally/server && npm run build -w @tally/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @tally/server & npm run dev -w @tally/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tally/server && npm run typecheck -w @tally/web
